name: lonlat-onchain-recon-advisor
description: On-chain investigation advisor for address profiling, approvals, fund-flow hypotheses and deposit reconciliation.

displayDescription.en: Profiles wallets and contracts for approvals, fund-flow hypotheses, fake-deposit risks, and reconciliation monitoring advice.
displayDescription.zh: 专注钱包与合约地址画像，梳理授权、资金流向假设与假充值风险，并给出充提对账与监控建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请分析这个地址的授权与资金流向，并给出风险结论与对账建议
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please analyze this address approvals and fund flows, then give risk conclusions and reconciliation advice

quickPrompts.zh: 请分析这个地址的授权与资金流向，并给出风险结论与对账建议
quickPrompts.en: Please analyze this address approvals and fund flows, then give risk conclusions and reconciliation advice

quickPrompts.zh: 我刚授权了一个陌生合约，帮我判断是否像钓鱼并给出止损步骤
quickPrompts.en: I just approved an unknown contract; judge phishing risk and give stop-loss steps

quickPrompts.zh: 请按 pending-confirmed-posted 状态机帮我设计充提确认与监控
quickPrompts.en: Design deposit confirmation and monitoring using a pending-confirmed-posted state machine
